mapper.select: SELECT * FROM scheduled_occurrence WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND schedule_id = #{schedule} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT o.*, r.error_message, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM run_attempt a WHERE a.enterprise_id = o.enterprise_id AND a.run_id = o.run_id) AS attempt_count FROM scheduled_occurrence o LEFT JOIN agent_run r ON r.enterprise_id = o.enterprise_id AND r.id = o.run_id WHERE o.enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND o.schedule_id = #{schedule} AND o.occurrence_key = #{key}

SELECT o.*, r.error_message, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM run_attempt a WHERE a.enterprise_id = o.enterprise_id AND a.run_id = o.run_id) AS attempt_count FROM scheduled_occurrence o LEFT JOIN agent_run r ON r.enterprise_id = o.enterprise_id AND r.id = o.run_id WHERE o.enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND o.run_id = #{run}

SELECT o.*, r.error_message, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM run_attempt a WHERE a.enterprise_id = o.enterprise_id AND a.run_id = o.run_id) AS attempt_count FROM scheduled_occurrence o LEFT JOIN agent_run r ON r.enterprise_id = o.enterprise_id AND r.id = o.run_id WHERE o.enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND o.schedule_id = #{schedule} AND o.id = #{id}

SELECT o.*, r.error_message, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM run_attempt a WHERE a.enterprise_id = o.enterprise_id AND a.run_id = o.run_id) AS attempt_count FROM scheduled_occurrence o LEFT JOIN agent_run r ON r.enterprise_id = o.enterprise_id AND r.id = o.run_id WHERE o.enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND o.schedule_id = #{schedule} ORDER BY o.scheduled_for DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ranked.* FROM ( SELECT o.*, r.error_message, s.active_occurrence_id AS current_active_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM run_attempt a WHERE a.enterprise_id = o.enterprise_id AND a.run_id = o.run_id) AS attempt_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.enterprise_id, o.schedule_id ORDER BY o.scheduled_for DESC, o.id DESC) AS occurrence_rank FROM scheduled_occurrence o INNER JOIN scheduled_task s ON s.enterprise_id = o.enterprise_id AND s.id = o.schedule_id LEFT JOIN agent_run r ON r.enterprise_id = o.enterprise_id AND r.id = o.run_id WHERE o.enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND o.schedule_id IN #{schedule} ) ranked WHERE occurrence_rank = 1 OR id = current_active_id ORDER BY schedule_id, scheduled_for DESC, id DESC
